context: Incident news: Sakura and Ren on a traffic accident.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: incident news; safety vocabulary (警察/被害/事故/批判/リスク) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今朝、交差点で事故が起きました。
lines.en: An accident happened at an intersection this morning.
lines.style: crisp adult anchor voice, soft warm serious clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害の大きさは、どうですか?
lines.style: measured young reporter voice, soft warm serious focus throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 幸い、大きな被害はありませんでした。
lines.en: Fortunately, there was no major damage.
lines.style: clear adult anchor voice, soft warm serious clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察は、原因を調べていますか?
lines.en: Are the police investigating the cause?
lines.style: serious young reporter voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、警察が現場を調べています。
lines.en: Yes, the police are examining the scene.
lines.style: professional adult anchor voice, soft warm serious clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 事故のリスクは、減らせますか?
lines.en: Can the risk of accidents be reduced?
lines.style: thoughtful young reporter voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 対策の遅れに、批判も出ています。
lines.en: Criticism is rising over the delayed measures.
lines.style: measured adult anchor voice, soft warm serious clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: リスクを下げる工夫が、急がれますね。
lines.en: Efforts to lower the risk are urgent.
lines.style: earnest young reporter voice, soft warm calm closing throughout
